title: Do these 3 every day this week while the bath fills
caption: Exercises to do while the bath fills: Wall Sit, Wall Slide and Standing Hip Hinge, three rounds in about seven minutes. One wall, no floor and no noise, so nobody down the hall hears a thing. Save this for bath time.

overlays.text: Do these 3 every day this week while the bath fills.

scenes.footer: Squat. Any wall near the tub works.

overlays.text: Wall Sit. 30 second hold. Back flat on the wall, knees bent, hold still.
Wall Slide. 10 reps. Back on the wall, slide your arms up and down slowly.

scenes.footer: Hinge. The bath mat is all the room you need.

overlays.text: Standing Hip Hinge. 10 reps. Push your hips back, keep your back flat, stand tall.

scenes.footer: All three keep you on your feet and off the wet floor.

overlays.text: No push and no core this week. Both come back next week.

scenes.footer: You built that while the water ran.

overlays.text: Three rounds of the three. About seven minutes, done before the bath is full.
Which of the three felt hardest?
